title: 形成三的最大倍数
summary: 从给定数字中选取若干位并任意排序，形成能被三整除的最大整数。
insight: 数字和对三的余数决定需要删除的最小数字：余一时删一个余一或两个余二，余二时反之；最后降序拼接。
pitfalls: 删除时选择数值最小的可行数字
无法保留任何位时返回空串

solutions.title: 余数贪心计数
solutions.idea: 用十个数字的频次完成最小损失的余数修正。
steps: 统计 count 与 digit sum
按 sum%3 优先删除一个同余数字，否则删除两个互补余数数字
从 9 到 0 降序输出；首位为零则返回 0

code.java: class Solution { private boolean remove(int[] count,int remainder,int amount){for(int digit=0;digit<=9&&amount>0;digit++)while(count[digit]>0&&digit%3==remainder&&amount>0){count[digit]--;amount--;}return amount==0;}public String largestMultipleOfThree(int[] digits){int[] count=new int[10];int sum=0;for(int digit:digits){count[digit]++;sum+=digit;}int remainder=sum%3;if(remainder==1&&!remove(count,1,1)&&!remove(count,2,2))return "";if(remainder==2&&!remove(count,2,1)&&!remove(count,1,2))return "";StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int digit=9;digit>=0;digit--)while(count[digit]-->0)answer.append(digit);if(answer.length()>0&&answer.charAt(0)=='0')return "0";return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun largestMultipleOfThree(digits:IntArray):String{val count=IntArray(10);var sum=0;for(digit in digits){count[digit]++;sum+=digit};fun remove(remainder:Int,needed:Int):Boolean{var amount=needed;for(digit in 0..9)while(count[digit]>0&&digit%3==remainder&&amount>0){count[digit]--;amount--};return amount==0};val remainder=sum%3;if(remainder==1&&!remove(1,1)&&!remove(2,2))return "";if(remainder==2&&!remove(2,1)&&!remove(1,2))return "";val answer=StringBuilder();for(digit in 9 downTo 0)repeat(count[digit]){answer.append(digit)};return if(answer.isNotEmpty()&&answer[0]=='0')"0" else answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string largestMultipleOfThree(vector<int>& digits){int count[10]={},sum=0;for(int digit:digits){++count[digit];sum+=digit;}auto remove=[&](int remainder,int amount){for(int digit=0;digit<=9&&amount;digit++)while(count[digit]&&digit%3==remainder&&amount){--count[digit];--amount;}return amount==0;};int remainder=sum%3;if(remainder==1&&!remove(1,1)&&!remove(2,2))return "";if(remainder==2&&!remove(2,1)&&!remove(1,2))return "";string answer;for(int digit=9;digit>=0;--digit)answer+=string(count[digit],char('0'+digit));return !answer.empty()&&answer[0]=='0'?"0":answer;} };
